definitions.usage: according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.
definitions.full: H3644. kemo or kamo כְּמוֺ adverb and conjunction like, as, when (literally the like of what (namely) . . ., a pleonastic form of כְּ (see מוֺ ), and, like it, properly a substantive : compare Aramaic כְּמָא like Psa 78:68 Levy, usually דְּ כְּמָא like as ; (i.e. ) like what, like , usually followed by like as ; Samaritan ; Arabic Ethiopic kama, like as , Di Gr § 63 a Sabean כמו ZMG 1883, 394 ) — used 1 (56 t.) as an independent word (except Gen 19:15 ; Neh 9:11 , only in poetry); 2 as an equivalent for כְּ before suffixes, always before light ones, and occasionally before heavy ones (see כְּ at the beginning): — 1. a. adverb, as poetic synonym of כְּ , like, as , Exod 15:5 they went down כמואֿבן like a stone (hence in prose Neh 9:11 ), 9:8 ( Psa 78:13 ), Isa 30:22 ; 51:6 (see כֵּן ), 26:17 לָלֶרֶת תַּקְרִיב חָרָח כְּמוֺ (see כְּ 1c (2), on the construct: so 41:25 ; Psa 58:5 , 8 a,9), Isa 26:18 we have brought forth the like of, as it were , wind, Jer 13:21 ; 15:18 ; 50:26 ; Ezek 16:57 ( עת כמו as at the time of: see כְּ Note ), Hosea 7:4 ; 8:12 ; 13:7 ; Hab 3:14 ( as it were ), Zech 9:15 ; 10:2 , 7 (as with wine: see ib.) Elsewhere chiefly in Psalms (19 t.) and Job (11 t.), as Psa 29:6 ; 61:7 ; 63:6 ; 78:69 ; 79:5 ; 88:6 ; 90:9 ; Job 6:15 ; 10:22 (twice in verse); 12:3 אלה כמו the like of these things , 14:9 ; Song 6:10 ; 7:2 ; Lam 4:6 רגע כמו (in prose כרגע ). Repeated, like כְּ ֗֗֗ כְּ , Psa 58:10 ; and answered by כֵּן Isa 26:17 . — Psa 58:8 b יתמוללו כמו , as it were is against usage of כמו (with a verb), and yields a lame sense: read perhaps ׳ית [ חָצִיר ] כמו (Lag Che); 73:15 if I said, כְמ֑וֺ אֲסַמְּרָה , the text is untranslateable, the rendering thus for כמו being indefensible: probably הֵנָּה has dropped out before the following ׃הִנֵּה for הֵנָּה כְּמוֺ the like of these things , compare Job 23:14 כָּהֵנָּה , and 12:3 above b. conjunction = כַּאֲשֶׁר : (a) of time, once, Gen 19:15 הַשַּׁחַר עָלָה כְּמוֺ when the dawn arose; ( β ) of mode, according as , Zech 10:8 רָבוּ כְּמוֺ וְרָבוּ Prov 23:7 (answered by כֵּן ). — For 2 (before suffixes), see עכּ .
definitions.rootNote: or כָּמוֹ ; a form of the prefix k , but used separately [compare 3651 ];
